name: Mailchimp
oneLiner: Email marketing and automation platform from Intuit, priced by contact-count band, with ecommerce features on every paid tier and a free plan for up to 250 contacts.
summary: Mailchimp is Intuit's email marketing and marketing-automation platform, sold across four plans — Free, Essentials, Standard and Premium — priced primarily by how many contacts are on the account. Essentials and Standard add automation flows, an SMS/MMS add-on and ecommerce-oriented features such as purchase-behavior segmentation, while Premium removes the seat cap and adds phone support and a dedicated onboarding specialist. Price rises in fixed contact-count bands rather than smoothly, and the free plan is capped at 250 contacts.
notFor: Buyers who need an exact price between the published contact bands: only the 1,000/10,000/50,000-contact bands were verified here, and the price jumps at each band boundary rather than scaling smoothly
Teams that need SMS at a fixed, known monthly cost: Mailchimp's SMS credit pricing varies by sending country and isn't published as a flat rate
Accounts past 50,000 contacts that want to stay on the cheapest plan: Essentials tops out at 50,000 contacts ($385/month) and needs an upgrade to Standard or Premium beyond that
pros: Self-serve 14-day free trial on Standard and Essentials, no sales call required
Purchase behavior tracking and personalized product recommendations included on every plan, including Free
Annual pre-pay pricing (about 15% off) becomes available once an account reaches 10,000+ contacts, alongside the standard monthly rate
300+ integrations included on every plan, including Free
cons: Price rises in fixed contact-count bands, so a small increase in list size can jump the account into a materially more expensive band
Essentials tops out at 50,000 contacts ($385/month); larger lists require Standard or Premium
SMS/MMS add-on pricing isn't published as a flat rate; it requires an application/approval process and a monthly credit purchase
Free plan is capped at 250 contacts and 500 sends/month, tighter than some competitors' free tiers
Standard tops out at 5 seats and Essentials at 3 seats; larger teams need Premium regardless of contact-list size
